description: Handwritten version 1 waits: an approval wait parked on an event or a wake time with a timeout, a run deadline, an approval TTL and a chat binding; a budget wait woken by its wake time; a question woken by a real answer; a question that timed out unanswered with uncertain release; a redacted question resumed after its uncertain release was reconciled and after a new policy layer; an approval woken by a decision a millisecond before its expiry and then ended by its deadline; a question its run deadline ended unwoken, unanswered; an approval resumed under an admitted model and an admitted artifact revision; an approval whose approved call did not settle by its expiry, ended after its claim (#266 N1). Each wait has its own wake key (#265 M1). Every wait pins its execution authority; an approval wait carries its binding and expires. refused fail the schema and both readers; readerRefused hold the rules the schema cannot state and fail both readers. readerRefused also pins one whitespace set and one case fold (#265 M4): blank is only JavaScript's \s and U+0085, and labels are compared trimmed, each code point lowercased alone, final sigma as sigma. #226 adds three reauthorization waits: one parked on a trusted disposition with a wait deadline; one resumed after a same-principal refresh whose narrower permissions still cover the operation; one parked while the run's approved call was unsettled, carrying that approval's binding and expiry, its disposition revoked. readerRefused hold their rules: the pending operation, connection and cause are the disposition's; the condition is an event with no wake time; no TTL; an approval binding only with its expiry and its source pinned; a resumed one carries the refresh, for the parked principal, covering what is required, taken after the park and no later than the claim; and no other wait carries either.
